newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's central bank buys dollars at 887.30.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's central bank buys dollars at 887.30.

text.p: South Korea's central bank bought dollars at 887.30 in afternoon trading to limit the won's rise, dealers said.
The dollar rose to 887.70 just after the Bank of Korea's intervention.
Dealers said the intervention would push the won down to 888.40-50 by the end of afternoon trading.
"The intervention has turned the market around and traders are buying dollars after the central bank intervention," said a local bank official.
The won opened at 887.50 on Wednesday and ended the morning session at a low of 887.20 as dealers cautiously sold dollars amid fear of an intervention.
Dealers said the central bank had previously intervened at the 888 level.
